front: When was the People's Republic of China proclaimed?
back: 1 October 1949, by Mao Zedong in Beijing.

front: When did the Qing dynasty fall?
back: 1911-1912; the last emperor, Puyi, abdicated in February 1912.
A military commander controlling a region with his own army; warlords dominated China from 1916 to 1928.
October 1934 to October 1935, from Jiangxi to Shaanxi; fewer than 10,000 of roughly 80,000-90,000 finished (estimates).
Chiang Kai-shek turned on the Communists in Shanghai, ending the First United Front.
December 1936: Chiang was detained by one of his generals and agreed to a united front against Japan.

front: How did the Communists win peasant support?
back: Land reform and rent cuts, disciplined soldiers, resistance to Japan, peasant councils; the Guomindang by contrast was corrupt and brutal.
Corruption; hyperinflation; reliance on landlords and no land reform; brutal conscription (and losses against Japan).
Fighting by small mobile groups that avoid large battles and rely on the support of the local population.
